access.title: Shiga na Malamai
access.intro: Shigar da lambar da ke cikin abin da kuka sauke na MyPhonicsBooks daga TPT don buɗe dukan ɗakin karatu — kowane littafi, kowace takardar aiki, kyauta.
access.footer: Ana ba da lambobi tare da kowane kayan MyPhonicsBooks a Teachers Pay Teachers. Ba malami ba ne? <link>Duba ɗakin karatu na iyaye</link>.
